narration: Start in the familiar transcript log, where every turn, tool call, and result appears in chronological order.
Open the map with Ctrl+Shift+M. The Overview level shows your entire session structure at a glance: phases, delegations, and compactions.
Switch to Execution level for turn-by-turn detail. Each node represents a message, tool, or result, connected by causal edges.
Click any node to inspect it. Here, a file node reveals the full diff with syntax highlighting.
Press Escape to return to the transcript instantly. The map and log are always one keystroke apart.
Enable 3D orbit mode for spatial exploration. Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom, and see your session from any angle.
Timeline layout arranges nodes by time, showing the session's temporal flow from start to finish.
Hierarchy layout reveals the delegation structure: parent sessions, subagents, and their relationships.
Responsive design works on narrow screens. The toolbar collapses, and the inspector becomes a bottom sheet.
Full light and dark theme support, with semantic colors that adapt to your preference.
Ribbon layout provides a compact overview, stacking turns horizontally for quick scanning.
Matrix layout shows relationships between nodes as a grid, ideal for spotting patterns in tool usage.
Toggle the changed files rail to see every file modification in the session, with diffs a click away.
Layered 3D mode stacks turns by depth, creating a visual timeline you can fly through.
Depth stack adds perspective fade: cards face the camera for readability at any angle.
Smooth zoom with semantic zoom levels. At 150 percent, node labels remain crisp and readable.
Maximum zoom reveals full node detail: tool input, output, and metadata without leaving the map.
Search focuses on a turn node. Type to filter, or use natural language like 'failed tools'.
Another turn with different context: search results highlight in place without layout movement.
Trace failure chains through the graph. Red edges show error propagation from tool to result to compaction.
Tree layout organizes nodes hierarchically, perfect for delegation-heavy sessions.
Force-directed layout creates organic structure. Nodes repel, edges attract, revealing clusters naturally.
3D perspective with card-facing keeps text readable even at extreme angles.
Hybrid surface shows the map and transcript together: split view for context and detail simultaneously.
Click 'Why?' on any node to see its causal trace: why this tool ran, what it produced, what followed.
Fold groups to reduce noise. Collapsed groups show a badge with node count; token bursts animate the badge.
Side-by-side arrangement in hybrid view: transcript on the left, map on the right, linked by selection.
Natural language query: type 'failed tools' and it compiles to 'kind:tool status:failed' automatically.
Type 'failed' alone and it compiles to 'status:failed' across all kinds: errors, tools, messages.
Enable the trust lens with '?lens=unverified': a banner flags tool outputs that were never verified by tests.
Copy deep links to share specific nodes. The permalink opens the map at that exact node and layout.
First run shows a demo map labeled 'your session will appear as it runs': no empty state confusion.
